tut1.topic: Join To Create Voice Channel Setup
tut1.description:
**Setup:** `$setjtc #voice channel`
Join To Create Voice Channel Is Used To Automatically Create Temporary User Manageable Voice Channel, Use The Command `$channel` To Manage Your Personal Channel After Joining The Join To Create Channel, ex. `$channel userlimit 10`

tut2.description:
**Setup:** `$setautorole true`
Auto Roles Is Used To Automatically Add Roles To A Member When They Join Your Server, To Add And Remove Auto Roles Use The Command `$autorole` ex. `$autorole @role`, To View All Server Auto Roles Set Use The Command `$autroles` ex. `$autoroles`

tut3.description:
**Setup:** `$setsaveroles true`
Save Roles Is Used To Save A Members Role When They Leave, When They Join Back Their Old Roles Will Be Automatically Added To Them

tut4.description:
**Setup:** `$setprefix $`
Used To Set Your Server's Prefix

tut5.description:
**Setup:** `$autorespond add trigger ; response`
Used For Auto Responding To Messages, ex. `$autorespond add scam ; @scam`, `message: scam, bot returns: @scam`, To Remove Triggers Use The Command `$autorespond remove` ex. `$autorespond remove scam`, To View All Triggers Use The Command `$autorespond viewall` ex. `$autorespond viewall`, To Remove All Triggers Use The Command `$autorespond removeall` ex. `$autorespond removeall`

tut6.description:
**Setup:** `$setstatusrole true`
Status Roles Are Used To Add A Role(s) To A User Who Uses The Server Status Message In Their Custom Status, To Set A Custom Status Go To Your Profile Where You See `Account, User Profile, Privacy & Settings, Etc.` Once There You Should See A Button Called `Set Status` Click It, Now You Should See Multiple Buttons `Online, Idle, Do Not Disturb Invisible` You Should Also See A Button Called `Set A Custom Status`, Click It And Type In Your Server Status Message, To Add A Status Role Use The Command `$statusrole` ex. `$statusrole @role`, To Set Your Server Status Message Use The Command `$setstatusmessage` ex. `$setstatusmessage .gg/scam`, To Reset Your Status Message Do `$setstatusmessage reset`, To View Server Status Message Use The Command `$statusmessage`, To View All Status Roles Use The Command `$statusroles` ex. `$statusroles`

tut7.description:
**Setup:** `$blacklist @scam`
Blacklisting A User Will Disable Them From Using Scam Bot Until They Are Unblacklisted, To Blacklist A User Use The Command `$blacklist` ex. `$blacklist @scam`, To Unblacklist A User Repeat The Command Again, To See All Blacklisted Users Use The Command `$blacklisted` ex. `$blacklisted`

tut8.description:
**Setup:** `$setwelcomechannel @channel`
This Will Send A Greeting Message To A Member Who Joins, To Set The Server Welcome Message Use The Command `$setwelcomemessage` This Will Present To You A Couple Of Buttons, Read The Embed Description, To View All Welcome Variables Use The Command `$welcomevariables`

tut9.description:
**Setup:** `$antimessage`
When Enabled This Will Track All Unwhitelisted/Untrsuted Users And Make Sure They Send A Certain Amount Of Set Messages Amount Per Time Limit Set, To Set The Time Limit Use The Comamand `$setupantimessage time` ex. `$setupantimessage time 10`, To Set The Limited Amount Of Messages Per Time Set Use The Command `$setupantimessage messages` ex. `$setupantimessage messages 5`, Doing These 2 Command Will Allow The User To Send Up 5 Messages Every 10 Seconds

tut10.description:
**Setup:** `$whitelist @scam`
Whitelist A User Specified To Protect Them From Scam Bots Anti Commands, To Set A Whitelist Role, Use The Command `$setwhitelistrole` ex. `$setwhitelistrole @role`, To View The Servers Current Set Whitelist Role Use The Command `$whitelistedrole`

tut11.description:
**Setup:** `$trust @scam`
Trust A User Specified To Protect Them And Be Able To Manage Scam Bots Anti Commands, To Set A Trust Role, Use The Command `$settrustrole` ex. `$settrust @role`, To View The Servers Current Set Trust Role Use The Command `$trustedrole`

tut12.description: To Reset All Of Your Servers Data In Scam Bots Database Use The Command `$reset` Note* Once Data Has Been Deleted It Can Not Be Retrieved
